lede: The biggest thing to track this week is Telluride Town Council on October 6, where a public hearing on a development vesting extension sits on the formal agenda and a morning work session on Flock Safety's automated license plate reader cameras is set to generate real conversation about surveillance in a small town. San Miguel County's Planning Commission follows on October 8 with a joint BOCC work session on an Affordable Housing Code Update — still the most consequential policy lever the county has. Over in Ouray County, commissioners and city leaders are working through a draft intergovernmental agreement that could hand full law enforcement for the City of Ouray to the County starting next year.

notable.stake: Draft IGA could shift all Ouray City law enforcement to the County by Jan 2027.
